findings.conclusion: Original full008 crashed when random nonzero-Q bases made the shape integral -0.6842861649644458. Fix01 projects each basis to canonical zero Q before normalization. Do not present this repaired historical bug as a cause of the current completed full008 endpoint.

Actual endpoint replay re-evaluates signal and backpropagates the saved waveform adjoints. One manufactured full008Fix01 forward gives nonzero gradients to charge, response FIR, mean time, U-Net, mean head, joint physical head, shape head, envelope and local FIR. ShapeEncoder has zero first-step gradient because its downstream charge-head weight starts at zero; this is an initialization effect, not detach. This check does not establish good conditioning throughout scientific training.

All wave losses compare output marginals. QPSD condition membership is output Q, not input condition. The actual loss cannot distinguish a correct source-to-response mapping from an output permutation that preserves all output marginals. The manufactured 256-row example swaps two different shapes at each same-Q source condition: all eight QPSD bins remain supported, joint wave=0 and QPSD=0, yet paired voltage RMSE=0.01297636121341304 V and relative RMSE=0.45658849956660236. This is a proven objective ambiguity, not proof that full008 specifically learned this bad mapping. Same-scene population/composition agreement or externally supported comparison weights remain necessary for broad simulation coverage to imply a reusable response.

The mean residual is bounded pointwise by 0.20 in unit-peak coordinates, deterministic mean time scale is restricted to (0.5,2), and the FIR has a total absolute raw perturbation below 0.5 around identity. Each stochastic basis is forced to RMS=1, so positive rescaling of a raw basis changes no signal while its direction and the Cholesky coefficients remain coupled. Charge log-std is below 0.30, hence signal-charge CV below sqrt(exp(0.09)-1)=0.306878. These are exact representation/coordinate facts; saturation and Jacobian/gradient conditioning at trained endpoints were not measured here, so they are hypotheses to test, not demonstrated causes of the failed fit.

Joint charge/shape/time fluctuations are explicitly requested. Even with zero-Q bases, qsig multiplying a correlated zero-mean shape coefficient produces a nonzero waveform mean term: for fixed time, E[exp(eta_q-var(eta_q)/2)*eta_k]=Cov(eta_q,eta_k). Nonlinear random time warping also changes the mean shape. Qbar is the conditional mean canonical charge, but the zero-latent deterministic waveform is generally not E[signal|x]. This is a semantic/optimization coupling, not an implementation bug or a reason to discard the user's requested correlations.

010/014 train only the 1288 shape-head parameters over a no-grad frozen A. 015 M1 trains six bounded mean-adapter controls, while its M0 trains the shape head. 016 freezes A and B and trains exactly two charge parameters. Inheriting a frozen wrapper and merely setting requires_grad on its parent would not reopen the actual mean computation because _baseline_once remains no_grad and the invariant/optimizer methods enforce freezing.

The saved 012 report already shows one carrier direction where 0.1-LSB hard moving-crop finite difference has the opposite sign to the fixed-index STE derivative. Its supervised-proxy finite differences agree with AD. This supports testing observation optimization separately, but is a local frozen-010 result and cannot alone explain all full008 directions or training.

minimal_repair_recommendation.implementation_scope: A new signal class or thin N01Response008 subclass, approximately 120-180 lines, reusing existing source features, U-Net, charge/time means, FIR, observation and fixed005 components. Avoid inheriting the frozen 010/014 wrapper.
properties: Reopen the actual A computation and optimizer membership under the newly registered run; preserve old closed endpoints.
Project each voltage B to canonical zero Q; do not divide B by RMS or shape_Q, and do not multiply B by qsig.
Use the same Gaussian bank for alpha and eta_shape through the joint head; correlation remains possible while E[alpha*A+B*eta|x]=A and canonical Q=alpha*Q_A.
Initialize B small with explicit seed and measure actual voltage/gradient scale. Do not silently inherit the fixed 0.05*tanh amplitude cap of 014.

Retain deterministic mean_time. Initially express time-like fluctuations through learnable zero-Q voltage bases, or explicitly account for the conditional-mean shift if a nonlinear random warp is retained.
Use the root's separately audited signed integral/conditional-mean objective repair; do not expect architecture changes to resolve marginal-loss nonidentifiability.
minimal_repair_recommendation.claim_boundary: This is a minimal candidate formulation supported by algebra and current source facts. It is not a verified fix for the detector response until the registered truth diagnostic and actual TRAIN pilot pass.

single_truth_diagnostic.purpose: Separate implementation/optimization failure from absence of an input-conditioned training signal before increasing network size.
single_truth_diagnostic.teacher: One frozen artificial teacher. Generate its deterministic A_star from explicitly hand-set, nonzero parameters of the existing 008 mean family, with charge/time/residual inside its admitted range; do not load a scientific checkpoint. Add independently hand-specified smooth canonical-zero-Q voltage bases and shared-Gaussian mean-corrected charge fluctuations. Keep explicit source/latent pairs and a second fixed latent bank.
sequence: Fit the known paired teacher using voltage MSE on a small fixed manufactured source bank and explicit paired latents; report deterministic mean RMSE, conditional charge/PSD covariance error, and waveform error on the second fixed latent bank.

Only after paired fit succeeds, keep the same teacher, source bank, initialization and budget but apply the intended unpaired response loss. Recover known conditional quantities, not only global output distance.

If the in-family paired mean fit fails, investigate gradient/scale/optimization before claiming the mean family is too small. If paired fitting succeeds but unpaired recovery fails, prioritize objective/condition/population ambiguity. If both succeed, proceed to the single real TRAIN pilot and inspect signed charge-bin mean residual and activation/constraint saturation.
single_truth_diagnostic.success_definition: Root must freeze numeric tolerances before execution. Teacher fit is engineering/recovery evidence only; it does not identify a unique response from unpaired measured pulses or establish detector acceptance.
